mechanism: Both drugs are renally eliminated; gentamicin's nephrotoxicity may impair levetiracetam clearance, and levetiracetam does not inhibit gentamicin metabolism but concurrent use increases serum drug accumulation risk in renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) regularly; adjust levetiracetam dosing based on creatinine clearance if gentamicin-induced nephrotoxicity develops; ensure adequate hydration and avoid unnecessary concurrent use if possible.
